brief:
Forty-four couples married in a single ceremony in Dura, a southern Hebron town in the West Bank, according to Palestine News Network. The mass wedding brought together 88 brides and grooms in a community initiative designed to support young people and reduce the financial burden of marriage expenses.

The collective celebration reflected local efforts to assist residents navigating economic pressures while starting their married lives.

title: Dura hosts mass wedding for 44 couples facing financial strain
